answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 16074 Country: India Title: wat is substitute of dua qunoot in witr? Question: wat is substitute of dua qunoot in witr? Answer ID: 16074 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1487/1489/M=1430) One who does not remember qunoot by heart he should memorise it without any laziness and forgetfulness. And until it is not memorised, instead of qunoot he should recite ربنا آتنا فی الدنیا حسنۃ وفی الآخرۃ حسنۃ وقنا عذاب النار or at least اللھم اغفرلی thrice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
